note: City of McVille campground on McVille Dam reservoir at the east edge of town off ND 15: a triangular loop of back-in sites inside a shelterbelt, with docks, boat ramps, picnic shelters, a playground and a disc golf course. The stocked lake holds walleye, pike, trout, bass, bluegill and perch. --Claude
summary: City page + Set Your Sites API read: 39 sites (24 W/E 30/50 A, 13 of them with sewer; 4 no-hookup RV; 11 primitive), $10/$35/$45, walk-up on every site, online booking closes Oct 1, power-only winter. Groups written; nightly_low 35 -> 10 (no-hookup RV sites up to 60 ft); season year_round. Seasonal share ~3 of 24 hookup sites. Lakeview stands; pin ok. Phone change suggested.
flags: SEASONAL SHARE: of 24 hookup sites, RV Site 19 (minNights 365), RV Site 24 (minNights 300, closed to 2027-10-01) and RV Site 6 (minNights 90) are set up as long-stay; the other 21 take one night. Season passes are sold, but most sites are nightly. Google 4.4 (36). No drop rule applies.
FEES: nightly_low 35 -> 10. The four 'RV Site' 25-28 have no hookups at $10, three of them 57-60 ft; the city page calls this the Primitive Day Pass.

WATERFRONT: lakeview stands. On Esri imagery the sites sit inside a triangular loop and shelterbelt; the loop's east edge (~47.7620,-98.1666) is ~75-95 m from the reservoir across a band of trees and the shore road. The 11 primitive sites are not mapped anywhere read (the portal's info link is a Google Drive file, not opened), so none can be named for an on-water value.
PIN: stored 47.7618,-98.1668 is at the east corner of the site loop, ~115 m from Google's point: ok.
PHONE: (701) 322-4343 is the city office; the parks page gives (701) 331-0028 for the campground, and Google shows 701-807-1915. Suggest (701) 322-4343 -> (701) 331-0028.
WEBSITE: keep both (city page + Set Your Sites portal).
FACILITIES: the city page says 'Bathrooms' only; the stored derived showers=true (from a 2025 shower-house mention) was not confirmed and not rewritten.

LEAD: 'Lee Street Camping' - the City of McVille's in-town RV sites ($35 a day with full hookups, $200 a week, $600 a month; HHS 'CITY OF MCVILLE RV PARK LEE STREET EAST', 11 units). Not in campgrounds.json (only 6027 within 12 km). The weekly/monthly pricing suggests long-term use; unvetted.
